It highlights each company's strong performance, growth prospects, and analyst confidence, emphasizing their potential for future upside and risk management by investing across international markets. The author advocates for Ray Dalio's approach to diversification by including companies from diverse countries.

summary: This article identifies three international stocks—Alibaba Group (BABA), Nu Holdings Ltd. (NU), and Mercado Libre Inc. (MELI)—that offer true diversification for investors looking beyond U.S. markets. title: NVIDIA Blackwell-Powered Jetson Thor Now Available, Accelerating the Age of General Robotics
summary: NVIDIA has announced the general availability of its NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor developer kit and production modules, designed to power advanced robotics and physical AI. Powered by Blackwell GPUs, Jetson Thor delivers significantly higher AI compute and energy efficiency than its predecessor, enabling robots to have real-time, intelligent interactions. Industry leaders like Agility Robotics, Amazon Robotics, Boston Dynamics, and Figure are among the early adopters, praising its capabilities for running powerful AI models at the edge.

title: Chip Programming Firm Data I/O Hit by Ransomware
summary: Chip programming solutions provider Data I/O has disclosed a ransomware attack that impacted its operations, including communications, shipping, and production. The company filed an 8-K form with the SEC, indicating that the cyberattack disrupted several functions and that outside experts are assisting with incident response and recovery. Data I/O anticipates that the costs related to the incident will likely have a material impact on its financial results.

title: Nvidia faces Wall Street's high expectations two years into AI boom
summary: Two years after the generative AI boom, Nvidia's revenue has more than tripled and profits have quadrupled, making it a pivotal player in the tech industry. The company, which recently hit a $4 trillion market cap, is under scrutiny as analysts anticipate its fiscal second-quarter earnings report. Wall Street is keenly watching Nvidia's revenue growth, especially concerning its Blackwell product line and the potential impact of Chinese market restrictions, to gauge the future of the broader AI trade.

title: NVIDIA Blackwell-Powered Jetson Thor Now Available, Accelerating the Age of General Robotics
summary: NVIDIA has announced the general availability of its Jetson AGX Thor developer kit and production modules, powerful robotics computers designed for physical AI. Powered by an NVIDIA Blackwell GPU, Jetson Thor offers significantly higher AI compute and energy efficiency compared to its predecessor, enabling real-time inference critical for advanced robotic applications. Leading companies such as Agility Robotics, Amazon Robotics, Boston Dynamics, and Meta are early adopters, leveraging the platform to develop next-generation robots for various industries.

title: Temu-owner PDD tops revenue estimates, competition squeezes margins
summary: PDD Holdings, owner of Pinduoduo and Temu, surpassed quarterly revenue estimates but saw a decline in net profit due to increased investments in combating fierce competition. The company's efforts to maintain low prices in China amid a price war and its expansion into international markets like the U.S. have led to higher spending across various areas. Executives anticipate continued fluctuations in future profits as competition intensifies, prompting strategies like promoting U.S.-warehoused products and adopting a "fully-managed" model for Temu.

title: Carvana Co (CVNA) Gets a Buy from Citizens JMP
summary: Citizens JMP analyst Andrew Boone reiterated a Buy rating on Carvana Co (CVNA) with a price target of $460.00, following the company's shares closing at $357.81. This rating aligns with a Moderate Buy consensus among analysts, predicting a 15.91% upside from current levels. Despite positive analyst sentiment, corporate insider activity shows an increase in share selling, with the VP, GC, & Secretary recently selling 15,000 shares worth over $5.4 million.

title: NYSEARCA:VUG ETF Climbs to $460 Near Record Highs on AI Growth and Earnings
summary: The Vanguard Growth Index Fund ETF (NYSEARCA:VUG) is trading near its all-time highs at $460, driven by the strong performance of mega-cap technology stocks, particularly those benefiting from AI and cloud expansion. The ETF's outperformance is attributed to robust earnings from its top holdings like Nvidia, Microsoft, and Alphabet, with a forecast of further upside supported by anticipated Fed rate cuts and continued economic growth. While its concentration in a few large names presents a risk, VUG's low expense ratio and historical returns make it a compelling allocation for long-term growth investors.

title: CI&T Is Among 19 Global Leaders Selected for AWS Generative AI Partner Innovation Alliance
summary: CI&T (NYSE: CINT) has been selected as one of 19 global partners to join the exclusive AWS Generative AI Partner Innovation Alliance, making it the first Brazilian organization to achieve this. This partnership provides CI&T with access to advanced GenAI training, global business opportunities through AWS solutions like Amazon Bedrock and Nova, and direct collaboration with AWS leadership. The alliance reinforces CI&T's position as a leader in AI-driven transformation, focusing on secure, scalable, and impactful generative AI solutions.

title: Walmart Adds Next-Day Shipping for Third-Party Orders in Key Cities
summary: Walmart is enhancing its marketplace fulfillment service to offer next-day delivery for third-party orders in major US cities, including New York, Los Angeles, Chicago, Houston, and Atlanta. This move intensifies its competition with Amazon.com Inc. for online consumer spending. The big-box retailer is aiming to speed up delivery times for certain marketplace orders to capture more of the e-commerce market.

title: Stanford study finds AI has reduced availability of entry-level programming jobs
summary: A Stanford University study indicates a significant decline in entry-level programming jobs in the U.S. since ChatGPT's launch, with positions for workers aged 22-25 decreasing by 6% overall, and 20% for entry-level programming. The research, based on ADP employment data and Anthropic's Economic Index, attributes these reductions to AI-driven automation, particularly affecting software development, customer service, accounting, and administrative support. Older workers and roles where AI augments tasks rather than automates them show increased employment.

title: Coca-Cola's failed coffee investment faces uncertain future as sale rumors brew
summary: Coca-Cola's $5.1 billion acquisition of Costa Coffee in 2018 is facing an uncertain future, with CEO James Quincey acknowledging the investment hasn't met expectations and rumors of a potential sale brewing. Despite initial hopes of establishing a strong global coffee market presence, Costa's revenue has stagnated and execution has stalled, leading Coca-Cola to reportedly explore a sale for a significantly lower price. The struggles are attributed to intense competition in the US, challenges during the COVID-19 pandemic, and inflation impacting coffee prices, prompting the company to reassess its commitment to the brand.

title: These 3 Funds Are Riskier Today for One Reason
summary: This article identifies three funds—Alger Capital Appreciation, BlackRock Technology Opportunities, and Akre Focus—that have become increasingly concentrated in their top holdings over the past three years. This concentration, often driven by the outsized growth of mega-cap tech stocks, poses a significant risk to investors. The funds' high exposure to a few dominant companies means any market correction in these stocks could lead to substantial negative impacts on the funds' performance.

title: Procore and AWS Announce Strategic Collaboration Agreement to Accelerate AI and Improve Project Outcomes in Construction
summary: Procore Technologies, a construction management software provider, has announced a multi-year strategic collaboration agreement with Amazon Web Services (AWS). This agreement aims to accelerate Procore's product development in AI, data operability, and analytics, enabling construction customers to build more efficiently and reduce risk. Procore's platform is now available in AWS Marketplace, offering easier access and leveraging AWS cloud infrastructure and services to enhance productivity and data insights in the construction industry.

title: Procore and AWS teaming up to accelerate innovation in construction technology
summary: Procore Technologies and Amazon Web Services (AWS) have formed a multi-year strategic collaboration agreement to drive AI and product innovation in the construction sector. This partnership aims to accelerate Procore's product development in AI, data operability, and analytics, helping customers enhance efficiency, reduce risk, and make data-driven decisions. A key outcome is the availability of Procore's platform in AWS Marketplace, offering consolidated billing and the use of existing AWS spend commitments to customers.

title: Walmart is testing a new way to show off products from third-party marketplace sellers in stores
summary: Walmart is experimenting with integrating its online third-party marketplace sellers into physical stores by using digital QR codes next to display items. This initiative aims to bridge the gap between online and offline shopping, offering customers a wider product assortment and increased visibility for online sellers. The pilot program is currently live in one store in Cypress, Texas, with no immediate plans for wider scaling.

title: Kroger layoffs: Why the grocery giant is axing 1,000 corporate workers as it closes dozens of stores
summary: Kroger is cutting nearly 1,000 corporate jobs following a failed $25 billion merger with Albertsons and the closure of 60 stores. The layoffs aim to simplify the company and reallocate resources, with savings reinvested into new locations and store-level jobs. Despite the job cuts, Kroger's stock performance has remained stable, trading flat at $69 per share.

title: Kroger cuts nearly 1,000 corporate staff
summary: Kroger is laying off "fewer than 1,000" corporate administrative employees after an internal memo announced the cuts. These layoffs follow the planned closure of 60 supermarkets and will not affect store, manufacturing, or distribution center workers. The savings from these reductions will be reinvested into lower prices, new store growth, and additional store-level jobs.

title: Here's Why Sify Technologies (NASDAQ:SIFY) Has A Meaningful Debt Burden
summary: Sify Technologies (NASDAQ:SIFY) has a significant debt burden, with net debt of ₹33.2 billion against a market capitalization of ₹57.1 billion, raising concerns about potential shareholder dilution if the company needs to shore up its balance sheet. The company's low interest cover of 0.79 times and negative free cash flow over the last three years indicate high leverage and increased risk despite a 5.3% improvement in EBIT. Investors are advised to be cautious due to the company's balance sheet health.

title: PDD Holdings Inc. (PDD): A Bull Case Theory
summary: This article summarizes a bullish thesis on PDD Holdings Inc. (PDD), highlighting its rapid growth, superior profitability, strong balance sheet, and the global success of Temu. Despite strong fundamentals, the stock is considered undervalued due to its classification primarily as an e-commerce company and, more critically, its lack of capital allocation actions like share buybacks, which causes investor skepticism. The author stresses that while the operational excellence is clear, PDD needs to address shareholder alignment through capital returns to overcome its market discount.

title: Nutanix Reports Fourth Quarter and Fiscal 2025 Financial Results
summary: Nutanix, Inc. reported strong financial results for its fourth quarter and fiscal year ended July 31, 2025, with 18% year-over-year revenue growth and substantial free cash flow. The company added over 2,700 new customers and strengthened partnerships with AWS, Pure Storage, NVIDIA, and Google, while innovating its cloud platform. Nutanix also provided an optimistic outlook for the first quarter and full fiscal year 2026.

title: Nvidia Earnings Live: Results Come in Slightly Above Wall Street Expectations; Stock Slips in Extended Trading
summary: Nvidia reported Q2 results slightly above Wall Street expectations, with revenue soaring 56% to a record $46.7 billion, but data center revenue and lower-end guidance for the current quarter fell short of estimates, leading to a 3% stock dip in after-hours trading. Investors are closely watching CEO Jensen Huang's comments on the company's outlook, China business, and next-generation product pipeline, particularly the forthcoming Rubin platform and the potential $50 billion China market opportunity. Despite these mixed results and ongoing China trade policy headwinds, analysts remain overwhelmingly bullish on Nvidia's long-term prospects due to strong AI demand.

title: Monster Beverage Beats Nvidia, Amazon With 444,868% Gain
summary: Monster Beverage (MNST) has achieved the highest total return over the past 30 years, soaring 444,868% and outperforming tech giants like Nvidia and Amazon. A $10,000 investment in Monster Beverage in 1995 would now be worth approximately $44.49 million, highlighting its status as one of the most successful, albeit low-profile, long-term investment stories. The article details the top six best-performing U.S. stocks based on total returns from June 1995 to May 2025, providing a breakdown of each company's performance, key milestones, and average annual returns to offer insights into long-term growth potential for investors.

title: Kindly MD’s $5B Bitcoin Play Comes as DATs Raise Fears for Wider Altcoin Liquidity
summary: Kindly MD, a Nasdaq-listed healthcare firm, has filed for a $5 billion stock shelf offering after a significant $679 million Bitcoin purchase, aiming to make Bitcoin its primary treasury reserve asset. This move highlights a growing trend of corporate adoption of Digital Asset Treasuries (DATs), but analysts warn that Bitcoin-focused DATs could draw liquidity away from the broader altcoin market, potentially making the market structure more fragile.

title: Netflix Stock At $1,200: A Reality Check
summary: Netflix stock (NFLX) has surged by 70% in the past year, trading at over $1,200, driven by successful crackdowns on password sharing and the introduction of an ad-supported tier. However, the article suggests a "reality check" is needed as these growth levers are already in play, content costs are rising, competition is intensifying, and the current valuation of 47x consensus 2025 earnings appears priced for perfection, potentially leading to pressure if growth moderates. Concerns are also raised about sustaining subscriber growth and the impact of price hikes on cost-sensitive users.

title: Comcast NBCUniversal And Amazon Expand Distribution Relationship
summary: Comcast NBCUniversal and Amazon have expanded their distribution relationship across Peacock, Fire TV, Prime Video, and Xfinity X1. This includes adding Peacock's Premium Plus tier to Prime Video for subscription and renewing existing deals. The collaboration reflects NBCU's strategic approach to bundling, focusing on economic value and customer engagement, rather than just subscriber numbers.

title: Lumentum Stock Surge: Buying Opportunity?
summary: Lumentum Holdings Inc. (NASDAQ: LITE) has seen its stock surge by 7.74% due to positive market sentiment driven by strategic expansion into U.S. semiconductor capacity for AI-driven Co-Packaged Optics, strong Q4 2025 financial results, and upward revisions of price targets by analysts. The company reported robust revenue and net income, with a focus on Datacom products and cloud/networking growth, leading to assured financial liquidity and sustainable growth. Experts and market reactions suggest a promising trajectory for Lumentum, positioning it as a key player in evolving AI and optics industries.

title: Comcast’s Peacock Service Joins Amazon’s Prime Video Supermarket
summary: Comcast's Peacock streaming service is now available on Amazon.com Inc.'s Prime Video Channels, expanding the online TV supermarket's offerings. The ad-free version of Peacock will be priced at $17 per month or $170 annually, consistent with direct subscriptions from Comcast. This move integrates Peacock with other services like HBO Max and Paramount+ already accessible through Prime Video Channels.

title: Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN): Our Calculation of Intrinsic Value
summary: This article presents a Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) analysis for Amazon.com, Inc. (AMZN), calculating its intrinsic value per share to be $76.40. Despite Amazon's dominant position in e-commerce and cloud services, the analysis concludes that its current stock price of $228.01 is significantly overvalued, trading at a -66% margin of safety. The author suggests that the current valuation already prices in substantial long-term growth, leaving little room for error for value-focused investors.

title: Dick’s Sporting Goods Q2 2025 Investor Report Analysis
summary: Dick's Sporting Goods reported strong Q2 2025 financial results, with sales up 5% and a raised full-year outlook, yet its stock dropped due to investor concerns about the $2.4 billion acquisition of Foot Locker. The company's strategy involves shifting from product sales to integrated youth sports services through initiatives like GameChanger and House of Sport, leveraging the growing youth sports market. However, the Foot Locker acquisition represents a significant risk and integration challenge that could determine the company's future profitability.

title: Uber Eats Partners with Dollar Tree to Expand Retail Delivery
summary: Uber Eats has announced a new partnership with Dollar Tree to offer delivery services from nearly 9,000 of the retailer's stores. This collaboration expands Uber Eats' retail footprint into suburban and rural areas, providing customers with convenient access to Dollar Tree's everyday essentials and unique finds. To celebrate the launch, Uber Eats is offering promotional discounts and benefits for Uber One members.

title: Elastic’s stock jumps on impressive earnings and revenue beat
summary: Elastic N.V. exceeded Wall Street's expectations for its fiscal 2026 first quarter, reporting higher-than-forecast earnings and revenue, with Elastic Cloud revenue jumping 24%. The company also significantly cut its net loss by half and provided impressive guidance for the next quarter and full year. These strong results, attributed to its differentiated technology and focus on AI, caused Elastic’s stock to surge over 19% in extended trading.

title: Snowflake Stock Scores a New Street-High Price Target After Beat & Raise Earnings
summary: Snowflake (SNOW) stock surged after its Q2 fiscal 2026 earnings, reporting significant beats on revenue and adjusted EPS, largely driven by successful AI integration and strong product revenue growth. The company also raised its fiscal 2026 product revenue guidance, leading to a new 52-week stock high and multiple analyst price target hikes, including a new Street-high of $285 from Piper Sandler. Despite its premium valuation, Wall Street maintains a positive outlook due to its strategic positioning in AI and cloud computing, and robust ecosystem partnerships.

title: Marvell Earnings: Buy the Dip and Focus on the Fundamentals
summary: Marvell Technology's July-quarter results met management guidance, with revenue rising 58% year over year. Despite an 11% selloff due to tepid October-quarter guidance and concerns about custom accelerators, Morningstar maintains its $90 fair value estimate, viewing the downturn as a buying opportunity. The firm believes Marvell's long-term opportunity in AI, especially with custom accelerators and optical connectivity chips, remains promising.

title: Orion, Blink Charging, Applied Digital, Domo, and Urban Outfitters Shares Are Falling, What You Need To Know
summary: Shares of Orion, Blink Charging, Applied Digital, Domo, and Urban Outfitters experienced declines in the afternoon session as the market pulled back, particularly in the tech sector, due to profit-taking and accelerating Core PCE inflation data. title: Gold Royalty Corp’s Stock on the Rise: Analyst Upgrades and Financial Outperformance
summary: Gold Royalty Corp's stock has surged by 12.14% due to positive market sentiment and analyst upgrades, with Scotiabank and H.C. Wainwright raising price targets reflecting confidence in improved cash flow and successful asset operations.
